typescript_producer.behavior: Sends cancel on user cancellation without version or capability check

cpp_worker.dispatch: switch action_case: START -> start; STOP -> stop; ACTION_NOT_SET -> unsupported_action

go_relay.behavior: Decode binary, marshal ProtoJSON, unmarshal ProtoJSON with DiscardUnknown true, then reencode binary

rollout: Producer deploys first; old Go relay and C++ workers remain supported for one release
